en.text: The LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

zhSimplified.text: 法老攻击迦萨之先，有耶和华论非利士人的话临到先知耶利米。

zhTraditional.text: 法老攻擊迦薩之先，有耶和華論非利士人的話臨到先知耶利米。

en.text: The LORD says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华如此说： 有水从北方发起，成为涨溢的河， 要涨过遍地和其中所有的， 并城和其中所住的。 人必呼喊； 境内的居民都必哀号。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華如此說： 有水從北方發起，成為漲溢的河， 要漲過遍地和其中所有的， 並城和其中所住的。 人必呼喊； 境內的居民都必哀號。

en.text: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back for their children because their hands are so feeble,

zhSimplified.text: 听见敌人壮马蹄跳的响声 和战车隆隆、车轮轰轰； 为父的手就发软， 不回头看顾儿女。

zhTraditional.text: 聽見敵人壯馬蹄跳的響聲 和戰車隆隆、車輪轟轟； 為父的手就發軟， 不回頭看顧兒女。

en.text: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for the LORD will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

zhSimplified.text: 因为日子将到， 要毁灭一切非利士人， 剪除帮助泰尔、西顿所剩下的人。 原来耶和华必毁灭非利士人， 就是迦斐托海岛余剩的人。

zhTraditional.text: 因為日子將到， 要毀滅一切非利士人， 剪除幫助泰爾、西頓所剩下的人。 原來耶和華必毀滅非利士人， 就是迦斐託海島餘剩的人。

en.text: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?

zhSimplified.text: 迦萨成了光秃； 平原中所剩的亚实基伦归于无有。 你用刀划身，要到几时呢？

zhTraditional.text: 迦薩成了光禿； 平原中所剩的亞實基倫歸於無有。 你用刀劃身，要到幾時呢？

en.text: “‘You sword of the LORD, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的刀剑哪，你到几时才止息呢？ 你要入鞘，安靖不动。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的刀劍哪，你到幾時才止息呢？ 你要入鞘，安靖不動。

en.text: “How can you be quiet, since the LORD has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there he has appointed it.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华既吩咐你攻击亚实基伦和海边之地， 他已经派定你，焉能止息呢？

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華既吩咐你攻擊亞實基倫和海邊之地， 他已經派定你，焉能止息呢？
